data.one_liner: A widget for animating a set of images as an alternative to GIF files.
data.what_it_does: Animates a sequence of images with full custom controls like looping, boomerang, play, pause, stop, and skip. Supports local assets and online endpoints.
use_when: You need to animate a sequence of images with fine-grained playback controls
You want an alternative to uncontrolable GIF files
avoid_when: You can achieve the animation simply using standard vector graphics or Lottie files
You only need a static image
strengths: Full video-like control over image sequences (play, pause, rewind, skip)
Supports both local assets and online image paths with caching
weaknesses: Requires managing a large set of individual image files for the sequence
Basic initial implementation with minimal community ecosystem
data.setup_notes: Add image sequence files to assets and update pubspec.yaml accordingly.
